data.name: Ajaatshatru
data.gender_notes: Ajaatshatru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajaatshatru is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'aja' (invincible) and 'shatru' (enemy). The name signifies someone who is invincible and unconquerable, someone who cannot be defeated in battle. This name was given to King Ajatshatru of Magadha, who ruled around the 5th century BCE. He is most famously known for his victory over the powerful kingdom of Hastinapur.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Ajaatshatru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Invincible, Unconquerable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajaatshatru total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
